correctness.rationale: For hull of coaxial balls H(t)=max_j(r_j+c_j t), the width g(t)=H(t)+H(-t), t=|u.e|, is continuous convex even/nondecreasing on [0,1]. The distribution of t has strictly increasing CDF F_d=I_{t^2}(1/2,(d-1)/2), so quantiles of g(T) reconstruct g and the axial support of K-K. For two nonnested balls (radii R>=r, separation L>R-r), g(t)=max(2R,R+r+Lt); the minimum m=2R, maximum M=R+r+L and atom q=F_d((R-r)/L) invert to L=(M-m)/(1-theta), r=R-theta L, theta=F_d^{-1}(q). Three-ball examples A=((0,2/5),(1,3/10),(2,1/10)) and B=((-1,1/5),(0,2/5),(1,3/10)) have g(t)=4/5+(|t|-1/10)_++(|t|-1/5)_+ exactly for all directions. All component balls are pairwise disjoint and exposed on open normal intervals, but the exposed spherical radius multisets differ, precluding congruence. Independent exact Fraction checks verified 401 rational directional identities and a two-ball inverse grid.
